chars.HAMZA: HAMZA: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black slim jeans and white sneakers, a thin silver chain.
chars.HAJ: HAJ: an older man (no hair) wearing a white Moroccan djellaba with a beige knitted taqiya cap, round glasses and yellow babouche slippers.
chars.MOTHERZ: MOTHERZ: a middle-aged woman wearing a shiny purple kaftan with gold trim and a purple headscarf, many gold bangles.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a modest Moroccan living room with salon sofas, HAMZA stands pleading with big gestures, hands pressed together, in front of HAJ who sits on the sofa frowning, arms crossed, clearly unhappy. Open tension between them.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan living room. HAJ forces a tight awkward smile and pats HAMZA's shoulder, while HAMZA grins with excitement and raises a fist in joy.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan living room. HAMZA leans in insistently pointing his finger toward the door, demanding; HAJ leans back with raised eyebrows, uncomfortable.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: At night, HAJ sits alone on the edge of a bed in a simple Moroccan bedroom, holding his chin, deeply worried, staring at the floor.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: At night, HAJ kneels on a red prayer rug in a quiet dim room lit by a small lamp, hands raised in prayer, eyes closed, calm and serious.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In a busy Moroccan market street in Rabat, HAJ pays a shopkeeper with banknotes while carrying engagement gifts: a large silver tray with white sugar cones, wrapped boxes and a basket of dates. He looks tired but resigned.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In a narrow Moroccan derb alley with colorful doors, HAMZA walks proudly in front carrying a big decorated gift tray with sugar cones, HAJ follows behind carrying another tray, looking unsure.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: At the doorway of a Moroccan house, thick grey incense smoke drifts out from inside. MOTHERZ welcomes them with a wide fake smile and open arms. HAJ stops, sniffing the air suspiciously, nose wrinkled. HAMZA behind smiles happily, noticing nothing.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Inside a Moroccan salon, HAJ stares sideways with narrowed suspicious eyes at a small smoking clay incense burner hidden in the corner of the room, thick strange smoke rising. Mysterious tense mood.
